crossRefs.note: He died at a good old age, full of days, riches, and honor; and Solomon his son reigned in his place.
Abraham gave up his spirit, and died at a good old age, an old man, and full of years, and was gathered to his people.
Isaac gave up the spirit and died, and was gathered to his people, old and full of days. Esau and Jacob, his sons…
Now king David was old and advanced in years; and they covered him with clothes, but he couldn’t keep warm.
You will come to your grave in a full age, like a shock of grain comes in its season.
Of all my sons (for Yahweh has given me many sons), he has chosen Solomon my son to sit on the throne of Yahweh’s…
and ate and drank before Yahweh on that day with great gladness. They made Solomon the son of David king the second…
The king said to them, “Take with you the servants of your lord, and cause Solomon my son to ride on my own mule, and…

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

translations.web: Now David was old and full of days; and he made Solomon his son king over Israel.
translations.bsb: When David was old and full of years, he installed his son Solomon as king over Israel.
translations.kjv: So when David was old and full of days, he made Solomon his son king over Israel.
translations.asv: Now David was old and full of days; and he made Solomon his son king over Israel.
